metadata.question: Did New York experience an air temperature difference of at least 24 degrees Celcius between January 29 and February 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY or MODIS LST collections for temperature data - Need two dates: January 29, 2019 and February 5, 2019 - Location: New York City (approximately -74.006, 40.7128) - ERA5_LAND has temperature_2m band in Kelvin 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 reanalysis data (it's modeled, not optical imagery) - Need to convert Kelvin to Celsius (subtract 273.15) 3. Logic: - Get temperature for both dates - Calculate absolute difference - Valid zero would be 0°C difference (Valid result, answer B) - Null/Error would be if data missing or calculation fails (C1/C3) - If difference >= 24°C, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyc = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.006, 40.7128]); const date1 = '2019-01-29'; const date2 = '2019-02-05'; // 2. Data Acquisition const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY'); // Get images for both dates const col1 = era5.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(nyc); const col2 = era5.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(nyc); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Jan 29 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Feb 5 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get mean temperature for each day const img1 = col1.mean().select('temperature_2m'); const img2 = col2.mean().select('temperature_2m'); // 4. Calculate temperatures in Celsius const temp1_k = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyc, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m'); const temp2_k = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: nyc, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m'); const temp1_k_val = temp1_k.getInfo(); const temp2_k_val = temp2_k.getInfo(); if (temp1_k_val === null || temp2_k_val === null) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert to Celsius const temp1_c = temp1_k_val - 273.15; const temp2_c = temp2_k_val - 273.15; const diff = Math.abs(temp2_c - temp1_c); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Jan 29 temp: ${temp1_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Feb 5 temp: ${temp2_c.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature difference: ${diff.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (diff >= 24) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
